messages:
Maya: summarizing the reliability Q&A and follow-ups from todays all-hands. put things here so we have a single source of truth and owners. please shout if I missed anything.

Ravi: thanks — can we also include which customers to notify for Dedicated? a couple people asked in the live Q&A.

Maya: yes, adding a comms line. Ravi can you draft an email + status page blurb?

Ravi: I can do draft. target: email + status update before full rollout.

Zoe: quick tech recap for the morning fdisk error cascade: underlying cause was a control-plane GC spike that delayed config apply. RCA draft: https://redwood-internal/rca/INC-2026-gc-delay (internal). impact: brief 5xx burst across some regions.

Priya: is the GC scheduler change in the repo yet? we need the hotfix in prod ASAP.

Zoe: hotfix is in branch gc-scheduler-fix (PR 4321). canary scheduled. it adds backpressure and a small jitter to reduce simultaneous heavy GC.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: gc-scheduler-canary -> prod at 2026-04-28T18:30Z (build-d4c2e9).

Ben: Ill own verification / post-deploy smoke runs. will run the runtime smoke checklist and report here.

Maya: action items (reply to claim or update due dates):
```
- Publish RCA: https://redwood-internal/rca/INC-2026-gc-delay (Zoe) — final publish by 2026-04-29
- Hotfix canary: Zoe + Runtime (Zoe) — canary start 2026-04-28 18:30Z, gradate if green
- Post-deploy verification: Ben — smoke checks + latency sweep within 1h of gradation, report here
- SLO/SLI notes: Priya — add annotated query & temporary alert for 5xx/latency by 2026-04-30
- Premerge test: Priya — add test for GC load patterns to catch regressions by 2026-05-05
- Customer comms (Dedicated subset): Ravi — draft email and status page copy by 2026-04-30
- Exec summary + SLA impact numbers: Maya — collate and publish by 2026-05-03
```

Priya: claimed the SLO/alert work and premerge test.

Ravi: claimed comms; will request the Dedicated customer list from sales and post draft here.

Ben: after canary Ill paste smoke-run output and note any anomalies.

Zoe: small note from Q&A — someone asked about audit logs for config pushes. we should add a link in the RCA to the config-change timeline collector.

Maya: adding that to the RCA publish checklist.

prod-comm-bot: reminder: attach exec summary PDF to ticket when Maya marks RCA as published.

Maya: thanks team. plan to close this thread after canary is gradated and the exec summary is up. :thumbsup:
